description:
Run Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents anywhere, and pick up on any device.

Vicoa (Vibe Code Anywhere) runs the AI coding agents you already use, such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, on your own machine, and keeps every session in sync across desktop, web and mobile. Start a task on your laptop, follow it and reply from your phone, and get notified when an agent needs you.

Vicoa has no model of its own. It drives your existing agent CLIs through a local daemon, so you bring your own subscriptions.

The desktop app bundles the daemon and the `vicoa` command-line tool.
Bundles Vicoa CLI daemon v1.10.3.
🚀 Features
- vicoa-cli skill: fill in a task's priority and labels when filing it in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/commit/470af19
- Footer: link the new comparison page in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/commit/3c569a2
- Agents: get an agent onto a machine that has none in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/pull/279
- Backend: a migration can no longer stall the API behind a waiting question in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/commit/78c9629
- Tasks: pick several projects in the project picker in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/pull/282
- Tasks: a rate-limited task session no longer stops every dispatch in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/pull/281
- Sidebar: list a project's worktrees from the repo they belong to in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/pull/280
- Usage: find the Claude login in the Keychain by account in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/pull/278
- Tasks: move the project picker to the left, before Filter in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/pull/277
- Sessions: report why a session failed to start in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/pull/274
- Composer: stop scrolled options showing above the pinned list label in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/pull/276
- Sessions: keep the chat's scrollbar at the window's edge beside the summary card in https://github.com/vicoa-ai/vicoa/pull/275
